# About

```{r}
# Read in libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(tmap)
library(here)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
# Read in data

rast1 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif')
rast2 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif')
rast3 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif')
rast4 <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif')

highways <- st_read(here('data','gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg','gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg'), query = "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'")

houses <- st_read(here('data','gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg','gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg')) |> 
    filter(type %in% c('residential','apartments','house','static_caravan','detached'))
```

# Clean the data

```{r}
# Check that CRS match

if (crs(rast1) == crs(rast2)) {
    print('CRSs match!')
} else{
    warning('CRSs do not match')
}

if (crs(rast3) == crs(rast4)) {
    print('CRSs match!')
} else{
    warning('CRSs do not match')
}

# Merge rasters from same day

lights0207 <- merge(rast1,rast2)

lights0216 <- merge(rast3,rast4)

# Find difference in night light intensity before and after storms

lightdif <- lights0216 - lights0207
lightdif[lightdif > -200] <- NA 
lightdif[not.na(lightdif)] <- 1

# Transform raster into polygon and change CRS

vectlight <- as.polygons(crop(lightdif,ext(-96.5,-94.5,29,30.5))) |> 
    st_as_sf() |> 
    st_make_valid()
vectlight <- st_transform(vectlight, crs('EPSG:3083'))

# Check if highway data has same crs as light data

if (crs(vectlight) == crs(highways)) {
    print('CRSs match!')
} else{
    warning('CRSs do not match')
}

# Change CRS of highway data

highways = st_transform(highways, crs = crs(vectlight))

# Create 200m buffer from all highways, and subtract from light mask

buffhighway <- st_buffer(highways, dist = 200)

buffhighway <- st_union(buffhighway)

lightwithouthighways <- st_difference(vectlight, buffhighway)

# Check that houses data CRS matches light data CRS

if (crs(houses) == crs(lightwithouthighways)) {
    print('CRSs match!')
} else{
    warning('CRSs do not match')
}

# Match CRSs

houses <- st_transform(houses, crs = crs(lightwithouthighways))

# Subset houses that are in light mask

blackouthouses <- st_filter(x = houses, y = lightwithouthighways, .predicate = st_intersects)
```

# Difference in night light intensity before and after storms

```{r}
# Map of before

before <- tm_shape(lights0207) + 
    tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_rank(values = 'greys'),
    col.legend = tm_legend(position = tm_pos_in('center','bottom'))) +
tm_title('Before Storms')

# Map of after

after <- tm_shape(lights0216) + 
    tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_rank(values = 'greys'),
    col.legend = tm_legend(position = tm_pos_in('center','bottom'))) +
    tm_title('After Storms')

tmap_arrange(before, after, nrow = 1, asp = 0)

# Map of difference
```
